about.description: A tropical oasis offering the best of both Gulf and bay living. Perched on the edge of Little Lagoon with direct beach access across the street to the Gulf. Features waterfront amenities including tennis, pickleball, shuffleboard, boat launch, two piers, pool, hot tub, and picnic areas. All units feature either bayfront views of Little Lagoon or Gulf views.
about.elevator_pitch: Indulge in the best of both worlds with direct access to Little Lagoon and the Gulf beach across the street.
